t.zh: 到这里，像平面一直是无限大的，物体的像总能落上去。真正的相机只有一块传感器：相机台装上一块 20 mm 高、200 像素的传感器，<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>在中心。像落到传感器边外的物体，不在画面里。
t.en: Until now the image plane has been endless, and every image had somewhere to land. A real camera has only a sensor: the camera bench now holds one 20 mm and 200 pixels tall, its <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> at the centre. An object whose image falls past its edges is out of the picture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：要把几个物体全拍进画面，焦距该变长还是变短？三支箭都在 2000 mm 外，台上只有焦距 f 能动。第一个任务要三支都在画面里，中间那支乙又不能太小；第二个任务只拍乙，要它占满画面的高度。
t.en: This level asks: to get several objects into the frame at once, should the focal length grow or shrink? Three arrows stand 2000 mm away, and only the focal length f turns. The first task wants all three in view without the middle arrow B shrinking too far; the second shows B alone and wants it to fill the frame's height.

after.zh: 焦距决定看得多宽，这是<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>：传感器一定时，焦距短看得宽，焦距长看得窄、物体显得大。
after.en: How wide a camera sees is its <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>: with the sensor fixed, a short focal length sees wide, a long one narrow, with objects looking larger.

brief.zh: 调焦距，让三支箭的像都落在传感器上，中间那支乙的像又不少于 40 像素高。
brief.en: Set the focal length so all three arrows image on the sensor, with the middle arrow B at least 40 pixels tall.

hint.zh: 看两端那两支箭的像落在哪里，传感器的边又在哪里。
hint.en: See where the two outer arrows image, and where the sensor's edges are.

why.zh: 把焦距拉长想看清楚些：每支箭都变大，两端的落到了传感器外面。
why.en: Lengthening the focal length to see better: every arrow grows, and the outer ones fall off the sensor.

why.zh: 焦距缩到最短：三支都进了画面，乙的像却只剩 20 像素高。
why.en: The focal length as short as it goes: all three are in view, but B's image is only 20 pixels tall.

brief.zh: 只拍中间那支箭：调焦距，让它的像占到画面高度的 95% 以上，又不出画面。
brief.en: Only the middle arrow now: set the focal length so its image fills at least 95% of the frame's height without leaving it.

hint.zh: 上一个任务里读到过视场：焦距变长，它往哪边变？乙要占满 20 mm 的传感器，像要多高？
hint.en: The last task read out the field of view: which way does it move as the focal length grows? To fill the 20 mm sensor, how tall must B's image be?

why.zh: 缩短焦距：视场变宽，这支箭只占画面的一小截。
why.en: Shortening the focal length: the view widens and the arrow covers only a sliver of the frame.

why.zh: 焦距拉得过长：箭的像比传感器还高，上下都出了画面。
why.en: A focal length too long: the arrow's image is taller than the sensor and leaves the frame at both ends.
